question: Does per-environment exact action-free encoding reuse preserve Fast-LeWM CEM and closed-loop behavior while reducing B=50 fixed-observation solve latency?

cache_contract.scope: One solver.solve call only; reset before every solve, including every closed-loop replan.
cache_contract.identity: Entries are keyed by (active environment slot within the current solve, semantic role current-or-goal, exact pixels tensor contents). A hit requires exact input equality against the stored snapshot. Never reuse an embedding across environment slots or roles.
cache_contract.role_binding: Determine current-versus-goal from the frozen Fast-LeWM get_cost/rollout source path and verify each encode input against the actual current or goal pixels in that cost call; call parity alone is insufficient.
cache_contract.environment_binding: Use the solver's verified per-environment scheduling order to map each B=1 cost call to its environment slot, and assert that its current/goal inputs match that slot's solve-start observations. If runtime scheduling or inputs do not match the verified mapping, fail closed.
cache_contract.resident_bound: CEM is env-major with 30 consecutive rounds per environment and batch_size=1. Evict the prior slot on each verified slot transition; keep at most two entries (current and goal) resident. Do not clone or retain candidate-expanded image tensors.
cache_contract.mutation: Only model.encode on action-free current/goal inputs may reuse stored embeddings. Native get_cost, rollout, action encoder, predictor, criterion, torch.topk CEM update, candidate ordering, RNG, and returned plans remain unchanged.

fixed_context_stage.context: The first official solver.solve input for each seed, captured from the real 50-task evaluation before native sampling.
fixed_context_stage.pairing: Fresh solver and cloned input per measurement; restore identical global RNG and native CEM generator state for every native/cache pair. Alternate AB/BA within each seed; six timed repetitions permit three orders each way. Two warmups per arm. Cache construction is included in cache timing; cloning, warmups, and full-trace collection are outside timed intervals.
fixed_context_stage.trace: One unclocked native/cache pair per seed records every get_cost candidate-action tensor and cost tensor, plus final actions/costs. Compare exact tensor bytes, shape, dtype, finite values, actual active count, get_cost calls, and candidate scores.

closed_loop_stage.evaluation: Official stable_worldmodel.World.evaluate_from_dataset on the same 50 frozen task rows for native and cached arms, paired by solver seed 42/43/44.
closed_loop_stage.records: For every solve/replan, retain active environment count, cost-call/candidate-score counts, final selected actions and costs; retain all 50 ordered episode outcomes. Compare native/cache actions, costs, and outcomes per seed. Report each seed separately and paired task differences; the three repeated runs on the same 50 tasks are not 150 IID observations.
closed_loop_stage.timing: Report matched fixed-solve latency separately from complete raw evaluation wall time and the separately measured in-evaluation fixed-benchmark overhead. The reused official runner performs one warmup and three timed cloned solves before its first real solve; both arms retain this measured overhead. Do not estimate-subtract timing or infer deployment speedup from fixed-solve speed alone.

closed_loop.prior_native_control: For each seed, native outcomes should match the already completed Fast-LeWM 30-iteration result on the same task manifest; discrepancies are preserved and diagnosed, never tuned away.

stage_rule: If fixed-context trace fidelity or finite checks fail, stop before closed-loop except for execution fixes that preserve this freeze. If fixed trace fidelity passes, complete all three paired 50-task closed-loop seed pairs even if only the latency or memory scientific gate fails; stop only for actual OOM, unsafe resource state, or another technical failure. Do not tune to recover a failed gate.

resources.cpu_preflight: 1 CPU-only PBS allocation, select=1:ncpus=8:mem=32gb, walltime=00:30:00; source/runtime/interface and dummy identity checks only.
resources.gpu_candidate: select=1:ncpus=16:mem=110gb:ngpus=1, walltime=02:00:00, timeout=01:45:00, 5-second GPU UUID/utilization/memory telemetry in job.log. Do not submit before root review.

claim_limit: Fixed-context B=50 solver evidence plus paired closed-loop evaluation for one official Fast-LeWM checkpoint, three solver seeds on the same 50 task rows. No architecture or sparse-kernel claim; closed-loop timing applies only to this evaluation harness.
quota_rule: Do not use banked reset. If primary remaining quota falls below 40 percent before a new stage, do not start that stage; finish already authorized submitted work and report.
